verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד קְ֭רָאתִיךָ יְהוָ֣ה ח֣וּשָׁה לִּ֑י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ק֝וֹלִ֗י בְּקָרְאִי־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā Yah·weh ḥū·šāh lî ha·’ă·zî·nāh qō·w·lî bə·qā·rə·’î- lāḵ
verses.literal: A Psalm of David I call upon You O LORD come quickly to me Hear my voice when I call to You

verses.original: תְּפִלָּתִ֣י תִּכּ֤וֹן לְפָנֶ֑יךָ קְטֹ֣רֶת מַֽשְׂאַ֥ת כַּ֝פַּ֗י עָֽרֶב׃ מִנְחַת־
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî tik·kō·wn lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā qə·ṭō·reṯ maś·’aṯ kap·pay ‘ā·reḇ min·ḥaṯ-
verses.literal: May my prayer be set before You like incense my uplifted hands like the evening offering

verses.original: שִׁיתָ֣ה שָׁמְרָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְפִ֑י נִ֝צְּרָ֗ה עַל־ דַּ֥ל שְׂפָתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šî·ṯāh šā·mə·rāh Yah·weh lə·p̄î niṣ·ṣə·rāh ‘al- dal śə·p̄ā·ṯāy
verses.literal: Set a guard O LORD over my mouth keep watch at the door of my lips

verses.original: אַל־ לִבִּ֨י תַּט־ רָ֡ע לְדָבָ֪ר׀ לְהִתְע֘וֹלֵ֤ל עֲלִל֨וֹת׀ בְּרֶ֗שַׁע אֶת־ אִישִׁ֥ים פֹּֽעֲלֵי־ אָ֑וֶן וּבַל־ אֶ֝לְחַ֗ם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- lib·bî taṭ- rā‘ lə·ḏā·ḇār lə·hiṯ·‘ō·w·lêl ‘ă·li·lō·wṯ bə·re·ša‘ ’eṯ- ’î·šîm pō·‘ă·lê- ’ā·wen ū·ḇal- ’el·ḥam bə·man·‘am·mê·hem
verses.literal: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity let me not feast on their delicacies

verses.original: צַדִּ֨יק׀ יֶֽהֶלְמֵֽנִי־ וְֽיוֹכִיחֵ֗נִי חֶ֡סֶד שֶׁ֣מֶן רֹ֭אשׁ אַל־ יָנִ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י כִּי־ וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י ע֥וֹד בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq ye·hel·mê·nî- wə·yō·w·ḵî·ḥê·nî ḥe·seḏ še·men rōš ’al- yā·nî rō·šî kî- ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ‘ō·wḏ bə·rā·‘ō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Let the righteous man strike me let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion It is oil for my head let me not refuse it . . . For my prayer is ever against . . . the deeds of the wicked

verses.original: שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם נִשְׁמְט֣וּ בִֽידֵי־ סֶ֭לַע וְשָׁמְע֥וּ אֲ֝מָרַ֗י כִּ֣י נָעֵֽמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·p̄ə·ṭê·hem niš·mə·ṭū ḇî·ḏê- se·la‘ wə·šā·mə·‘ū ’ă·mā·ray kî nā·‘ê·mū
verses.literal: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs the people will listen to my words for they are pleasant

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ פֹלֵ֣חַ וּבֹקֵ֣עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ עֲ֝צָמֵ֗ינוּ נִפְזְר֥וּ לְפִ֣י שְׁאֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: kə·mōw p̄ō·lê·aḥ ū·ḇō·qê·a‘ bā·’ā·reṣ ‘ă·ṣā·mê·nū nip̄·zə·rū lə·p̄î šə·’ō·wl
verses.literal: As when one plows and breaks up the soil so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֵינָ֑י אֵלֶ֨יךָ׀ יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י בְּכָ֥ה חָ֝סִ֗יתִי אַל־ תְּעַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ê·nāy ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·nāy bə·ḵāh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’al- tə·‘ar nap̄·šî
verses.literal: But my eyes are fixed on You O GOD the Lord In You I seek refuge do not leave my soul {defenseless}

verses.original: שָׁמְרֵ֗נִי מִ֣ידֵי פַ֭ח יָ֣קְשׁוּ לִ֑י וּ֝מֹקְשׁ֗וֹת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rê·nî mî·ḏê p̄aḥ yā·qə·šū lî ū·mō·qə·šō·wṯ pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen
verses.literal: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me and from the lures of evildoers . . .

verses.original: רְשָׁעִ֑ים יַ֥חַד יִפְּל֣וּ בְמַכְמֹרָ֣יו עַֽד־ אָ֝נֹכִ֗י אֶעֱבֽוֹר׃
verses.literal: Let the wicked . . . fall into their own nets while I pass by in safety
